name: Raceme Letters
description: A cascade of tiny macadamia blossoms runs beside a panoramic portrait and a broad, softly set reading page.

name: Terrazzo Milk
description: A fragmented mosaic frame holds two offset landscape portraits, a bold slanting title and a clean central writing surface.

name: Hilum Press
description: A writing-led letterpress page with a large seed-eye impression, compressed type, a split colour baseline and generous prose.

name: Whorl House
description: A rounded triangular portrait sits among three radiating leaves above a centred title and a spare, open reading panel.

name: Orchard Weave
description: An image-free page with an interlaced member-colour edge, a small sideways signature and a broad bookish title.

name: Raceme Mobile
description: A slim blossom-detailed phone with a square contact portrait, offset speaker slots and a rounded conversation screen.

name: Milkglass Duo
description: A two-panel glass phone with its conversation above a paired contact dock and a slim illuminated hinge.

name: Roast Terminal
description: A miniature desktop terminal with a thick inset bezel, compact contact tile, square message cards and a pedestal base.

name: Orchard Pocket
description: A compact keyboard phone with a short landscape display, a small contact tile and four rows of miniature keys.

name: Whisper Kernel
description: A smooth pebble-shaped messenger with a wide earpiece, centred contact text and soft stacked conversation bubbles.

name: Hilum
description: A tiny round seed-eye imprint anchors a short open reply between offset coloured rules.

name: Butterfleck
description: An asymmetric miniature with a portrait corner, a short reply and a scattering of terrazzo pieces.

name: Blossom Pair
description: Two small portrait medallions hang from a fine flowering stem above a compact reply.

name: Crumbprint
description: A tiny upright note with a bold sans heading, a scattered imprint and a wide coloured lower lip.

name: Whorllet
description: A low, slanted leaf-shaped portrait sits below a short reply and a small member-colour leaf impression.
